caption: A long wooden fishing rod is tapped against a post, and the tip whips back and forth in a blur before settling.

sa.check: A long fishing rod and a post are present.
The rod is tapped against the post.
The tip whips back and forth in a blur.
The rod is long and wooden.
The tap comes first and the whipping follows.

pc.expect: The rod is still until it meets the post; the tip begins to whip at the tap and only then.
pc.fail: The tip is already whipping before the rod touches the post; or whips while the rod is held away from the post; or the rod knocks the post and the tip stays rigid; or the tip settles and starts whipping again with no second tap.

pc.expect: The tip's swings are largest right after the tap and shrink steadily until the rod is still; the blur narrows.
pc.fail: The swings grow after the tap; or hold the same width for the whole clip; or the tip stops dead from a wide swing.

pc.expect: The rod bends as a tapered springy pole: the tip flexes most, the handle end stays nearly straight, and the rod returns straight.
pc.fail: The rod kinks and stays bent; or the handle end whips while the tip stays still; or the rod bends into a loop like a rope.

pc.expect: The post stays fixed and upright; only the rod moves.
pc.fail: The post sways or leans at the tap; or the post's top whips like the rod; or the ground around the post ripples.

pc.expect: One rod and one post; the rod stays one piece and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The rod passes through the post; or the tip breaks off; or a second rod appears; or the post vanishes.

pc.expect: The rod's colour and its line guides, the post and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The rod changes colour; or the line guides move along the rod; or the post changes shape or colour; or the background changes.
